evidence_summary: Field populations from Assam tea, resistance ratio up to 134 to ethion and 65 to dicofol (leaf-dip bioassay)
reference: International Journal of Acarology (2019 online); authors to confirm

evidence_summary: Resistance to methamidophos in Egypt after three seasons of use; resistance ratio not yet checked
reference: Abou-Awad and El-Banhawy (1985), Experimental and Applied Acarology 1: 11-15

evidence_summary: Pyridaben-resistant strain from Hexi region, China; high frequencies of AChE target-site mutations across populations
reference: Zhang et al. (2026), Pest Management Science; pyridaben-resistant strain in Experimental and Applied Acarology (2023)

evidence_summary: Pyrethroid resistance linked to sodium channel mutation; chlorpyrifos resistance linked to AChE-1 mutation and amplification
reference: Nyoni et al. (2011), Pest Management Science 67: 891-897
